title: Position: A Roadmap to Impactful Pluralistic Alignment Research

bias_targets.methodology: Auditing frontier AI labs' public documentation and system cards (such as those from Anthropic and xAI) to analyze how they evaluate even-handedness, consistency, and sentiment differences across paired responses to mirrored, one-sided prompts on sociopolitical topics.
Auditing frontier model system cards (such as OpenAI's GPT-5.5/5.6 releases) to identify their evaluations of first-person fairness and demographic stereotyping based on variations in user names.

Reviewing literature that measures whether language model outputs disproportionately reflect Western, highly educated perspectives, and auditing Meta's 'Cultural and Pluralistic Alignment' evaluation which predicts user preferences based on country and locale demographics.
